scope: fixed-2007 selected-checkpoint first-birth origin/destination diagnostic; no household or GE solve

native_reuse.behavioral_timing: first-birth mass is taken from the age-j childless risk set, forced to n=1,m=1, then propagated one model period; a same-origin childless control is propagated with the same policies

measurement_limit: The native destination contrast and the added same-origin immediate contrast are behavioral branch diagnostics. Neither is an annual interpolation, simulated empirical regression, or matched empirical estimator.
availability: Selected checkpoint bytes are remote-only; the local normalized seed is not a selected point.
